ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Sects
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
The six factions of Jiuxiao for Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
Azure Peak Sword Sect, Silent Lotus Temple, Heavenly Cauldron Pavilion, Ancient Dragon Clan, Blood Moon Cult and the Rogue Cultivators. They only arrive in the world after the Convergence. Their disciples are generated already cultivating (realm, root and techniques by rank) and, by default, hostile ones never outclass your colony by more than one realm.
Requires Convergence: Era of Cultivation. Optional: Convergence: Races (dragon, qilin, phoenix and fox bloodlines among their members).
